responsibility: Specializes the Arm backend for Symbian OS. It changes cc1 defaults to disable implicit builtin expansion, hide symbols by default, force Symbian enum and wchar_t conventions, suppress default crt and library linkage, enable dllimport semantics, define Symbian-specific preprocessor macros and runtime-linkage assumptions, adjust init/fini array section attributes, and set relocation and DWARF policies expected by the Symbian runtime and loader.
